stories.title: Can the WNBA make its All-Star Game vibes last?
stories.summary: Controversy after controversy marked the first half of the WNBA season. Fans and players are hoping the league found a reset button during the celebratory Chicago break.

stories.title: Power Rankings: How every team can make a playoff push
stories.summary: Whether improving a playoff seed or carrying momentum into the offseason, finishing strong is a priority.

stories.title: Shanahan: Crash was my fault, report was wrong
stories.summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan wanted to make clear that he was at fault for the car accident that left him with multiple serious injuries two weeks ago.

stories.title: Sources: Browns' Ward again NFL's top-paid DB
stories.summary: The Browns and five-time Pro Bowl cornerback Denzel Ward reached agreement on a two-year, $62.2 million deal that includes $52.3 million guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Sources: UEFA weighs WC boycott over FIFA plan
stories.summary: UEFA is set to hold an emergency meeting this week, sources told ESPN, to discuss plans, including a potential World Cup boycott, to oppose a FIFA proposal to raise $20 billion from a sale of equity to outside investors.
